findings.title: List-page dealConvoByLead memo not reactive to bare markSeen
findings.detail: dealConvoByLead depends on [leads, deals, comments, dealHasUnread], and dealHasUnread keeps a stable identity across markSeen (it reads seenRef.current, not state), so the list dots won't clear in-place from a markSeen alone. Non-blocking because the only list-page markSeen path (handleAction('comment')) immediately router.push()es to View Lead and the component re-hydrates seen from localStorage on return; the memo also recomputes when comments change. Consider adding a seen-derived dependency or a comment if a future in-place mark-seen is added to the list.

findings.title: Deal-row dot colour differs from Lead-row dots
findings.detail: Deal rows use bg-amber-500 while Lead rows use bg-rose-500. This is pre-existing (prior commit 4a0e17c) and matches the Deal section's amber accent; it was left intact per the task scope. Cosmetic only.
